title: Reconcile direct topic homes and remaining journey depth
text: The nested source tree and documentation cascade now have direct homes. Every current registry command, function and skill has a direct concept mapping; the live crosswalk is checked without inheriting parent coverage. The four individual JOURNEYS gaps name tracking-choice, qa-adoption, preview-recipe and strategy-closeout with their owners, direct topics and evidence. Draft lesson questions remain research; a direct mapping does not prove teaching quality or live delivery. Existing FIRST-USER and COREWORK needs remain current work, while only the explicitly evidenced JOURNEYS depth is deferred.
owner: Current source reconciliation; JOURNEYS only for separately evidenced journey depth
